name: Tri-Plane Positional Encoding
definition: A mathematical derivation to incorporate positional encodings into tri-planes by expanding a 3D function f(x, y, z) into a sum of trigonometric terms (cos/sin) multiplied by 2D plane features, allowing an MLP to learn the coefficients.
summary: Tri-Plane Positional Encoding integrates frequency inductive biases into tri-plane representations to suppress noise, distinguishing itself by operating on 2D planar projections rather than 3D coordinates.
